# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> John Coyne Estates are delighted to present to the market this stunning 3 bed semi-detached home which has been extended at the rear and also includes a Detached Muti-Purpose Outbuilding. Ard na Carraige is a highly sought after residential location in the town centre and ideally located within a short walk to all amenities.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bed
- Plocha: 102 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B3
- Lokalita: 7 Ard na Carraige, Edenderry
